title: SwipeBite
description: A geospatial restaurant discovery application designed to help users find and explore restaurants through an interactive location-based interface.

title: Vinyl Wall
description: A Raspberry Pi-powered physical music system that lets users select albums using hardware buttons, automatically starts Spotify playback and provides a Flask dashboard for configuration.

title: Movie Comparison Web Scraper
description: A Python data project that collects movie information from IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, combines the datasets and analyses differences in ratings and rankings.

title: Regex Python Chatbot
description: A rule-based conversational chatbot using regular expressions and intent matching to recognise user requests, maintain simple conversation context and generate appropriate responses.

title: Quiz Website
description: A browser-based quiz application that loads questions from JSON, randomly selects questions, tracks the user's score and provides feedback.
